## Purpose and scope

What decision, defect, or release outcome does this change address?

## Change class

- [ ] Editorial
- [ ] Informative content/example
- [ ] Normative requirement/test/schema
- [ ] High-risk material
- [ ] Governance/scope/release

## Evidence and compatibility

Sources, affected IDs/assets, backward compatibility, migration, and known limitations.

## Safety, rights, and sensitive content

- [ ] No personal, victim, live-case, target, credential, or operationally sensitive data is included.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic, consented, anonymised, or non-sensitive public material.
- [ ] High-risk and misuse implications are documented and reviewed where required.

## Validation

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate_assets.py`
- [ ] Positive and negative fixtures updated when schema semantics changed.
- [ ] Markdown and machine-readable requirements remain aligned.
- [ ] Internal links pass.

## Review and governance

Required reviewers, public-comment window, conflicts/recusals, unresolved dissent, and release impact.
